\# Adds page limit validation for dispute evidence

\## What’s new

Stripe now validates the estimated compiled page count of \[evidence\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#update\_dispute-evidence) submitted when you \[update a dispute\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview). If the estimated page count of your text fields and file uploads exceeds the network page limit, the API returns a \`400\` \[error\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview) with the code \`dispute\_evidence\_page\_limit\_exceeded\`. This validation applies whether or not you set \[submit\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#update\_dispute-submit) to \`true\`, so you can catch oversized evidence before final submission.

\## Why is this a breaking change?

Previously, you could \[update a dispute\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview) with evidence of any length. Now, if evidence exceeds the compiled page limit, the request fails and returns a \`400\` \`invalid\_request\_error\` with the code \`dispute\_evidence\_page\_limit\_exceeded\`.

\## Impact

If your integration submits \[dispute\](https://docs.stripe.com/disputes.md) evidence through the API, requests that exceed the page limit now return a \`400\` error instead of succeeding. Update your error handling to check for the \`dispute\_evidence\_page\_limit\_exceeded\` error code. To resolve the error, shorten text fields or reduce the number of pages in uploaded files to stay within the limit.

2\. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
 \- If you don’t use an SDK, update your \[API requests\](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include \`Stripe-Version: 2026-09-30.preview\`

4\. \[Test your integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5\. If you use Connect, \[test your Connect integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).
